Annual crawfish festival in Chalmette. Boiled crawfish, crawfish bread, crawfish pie, crawfish jambalaya — mudbugs every which way. Live music, parade, amusement rides, games (egg tosses, sack races), food vendors. About 20 min east of NOLA.
